key_concepts: A survey questionnaire is a tool for gathering information from a group of people.
Survey responses can be collected and analyzed to find clues or answers.
Survey questions may ask about observations, frequency, preferences, and suggestions.
A good survey question is clear, relevant, and easy to answer.
Survey questionnaires include components such as a greeting, questions with answer choices
Environmental issues and concerns can be investigated using survey questionnaires.
Waste segregation and recycling are examples of environmental practices.
Separate containers for paper and plastics support waste segregation.
CLAY-GO is a cleanliness practice that can be observed in school.
